# system.exit

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Exit the current script.

```lua
system.exit()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua
-- close a system tool from a button
form.addButton(line, nil, { text = "Done", press = function() system.exit() end })
```

In a widget's `configure` form, `system.exit()` leaves the configuration page, as FrSky's gauge example does with an *Exit configuration* button.

## Used in

- [bluetooth](../../examples/official/bluetooth.md)
- [widget-gauge](../../examples/official/widget-gauge.md)

    ```lua
    local function goBack()
      if menuGuard and menuGuard.close then menuGuard.close() end
      local hadFrame, parentScreen = nav.pop()
      if not hadFrame then
        system.exit()
        return
      end
      openScreen(nav, menus, rootEntries, parentScreen, setEventHandler, setWakeupHandler, setPaintHandler, setCleanupHandler, taskGuard)
    end
    ```

=== "Example 3"

    ```lua
    local function flushExit()
        if not tool.exitRequested then
            return false
        end
    
        tool.exitRequested = false
        if system.exit then
            system.exit()
        end
        return true
    end
    ```
